desc: Derive the equivalence: an answer for value x is the largest divisor d of x with at least K array occurrences divisible by d.
Implement and sample-test a memory-efficient descending sieve that computes divisibility counts and maximal answers.
Evaluate worst-case time and memory practicality for N ≤ 1.2e6 and max(A) ≤ 1e6.
Implement fast stdin parsing and buffered stdout output.
